name: The Gurubashi Legends of Old
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

adventurer, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
narrative.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
